# Hollywood Branded Blog

> > Expert insights on celebrity endorsements, product placement, brand partnerships, and entertainment marketing strategies from Hollywood Branded.

Hollywood Branded, led by industry expert Stacy Jones, provides comprehensive resources on leveraging entertainment properties, celebrities, and influencers for brand growth. The blog covers product placement strategies, celebrity gifting, music video partnerships, and case studies from major events like the Oscars and Super Bowl.

## Key Topics

- Product Placement
- Celebrity Endorsements
- Brand Partnerships
- Entertainment Marketing
- Influencer Marketing
- Celebrity Gifting
- Brand Integration
- Social Media Marketing
- Music Video Partnerships
- Red Carpet Marketing
- Celebrity Brand Collaborations
- Hollywood Marketing Strategies
- Trade-Out Opportunities
- Streaming Platform Partnerships

## Product Placement & Brand Integration Guides

- [Product Placement Trade Out Opportunities in Hollywood TV and Film](https://blog.hollywoodbranded.com/product-placement-trade-out-opportunities-in-hollywood-tv-and-film): Trade-out opportunities guide ft. BlackBerry in House of Cards case study
- [How To #18: The 3 Key Steps To Leveraging Celebrity Gifting](https://blog.hollywoodbranded.com/missing-the-3-key-steps-to-leveraging-celebrity-gifting): Three key steps guide to leverage celebrity gifting for brand awareness
- [How To Reach A Global Audience Through Music Video Partnerships](https://blog.hollywoodbranded.com/how-to-reach-a-global-audience-through-music-video-partnerships): Guide to leveraging music video partnerships for global brand reach
- [Is The Business Of Product Placement Best Kept A Secret, Or Not?](https://blog.hollywoodbranded.com/is-the-business-of-product-placement-best-kept-a-secret-or-not): Product placement industry transparency & information sharing discussion
- [A Product Placement Christmas Story](https://blog.hollywoodbranded.com/a-product-placement-christmas-story): Product placement analysis of A Christmas Story holiday classic on TBS
